title: dryopteris levingei
intro: Dryopteris levingei, commonly known as the Himalayan lady fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is known to have various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve immune function, and act as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris levingei include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antibacterial properties, which can be used to treat various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
